title: Inkfist Dojo
blurb: You are an old master who can no longer fight, so you write kata: scrolls of moves your student performs one line per beat. Each challenger at the gate brings a pattern the old scroll cannot answer, and the word that answers it goes on the shelf. You never press strike; the scroll is the only verb.

shots.beat: Ox-Hide Ren's rematch: the fist is tempered
Four graduations on, the scroll parries Brother Gang
The Envoy's Gauntlet: one scroll names each challenger
